title: Update investigation continues after metadata access is denied

transcript.text: The Settings search box drops focus after I type one character.
May I read this running build's version, quality, and commit so I can compare it with the fix?

That's okay; we can continue without that metadata. If you are comfortable, copy only the version and channel shown by Help > About, or compare your version with the public Stable release notes. Neither option needs a launcher, Git, the GitHub CLI, or a GitHub account. We can also keep these reproduction steps and resume later.
